observations.meaning: initial player apple count in the recorded normal-mode run

static_correlation: PLAYER_ANIM_THROW_APPLE at 0x001223DA is a canonical player action stream.
Its data-driven path reaches the FB callback that invokes InteractionCounter_DecrementPrimaryDigits.
Render_BuildActorRecords emits the same ASCII word in the HUD when it is nonzero.
qualification: This closes the player-facing resource projection of FFEFE0 without claiming that shared interaction/resource callers use a different storage location.
conclusion: The shared ASCII word at FFEFE0 is the player apple count in the recorded gameplay path. It starts at 10, the A/apple action enters PLAYER_ANIM_THROW_APPLE, and the word becomes 09 after the decrement callback. INTERACTION_COUNTER_DIGITS remains the address-level canonical name; PLAYER_APPLE_COUNT_DIGITS is its semantic alias.
